I replied to you in the thread: the depot was **Southgate**.

On 3 Sep 2025, Priyanka posted in #inc-tansley-carrier-api that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked by door 4 while labels weren't printing. Later that day she posted that Southgate had cleared the backlog and the incident was resolved.

I couldn't find a street address or site code for the depot in any file I can see. If you need one for the call, Priyanka is the person to ask.
